dct_title_s: Palestinae sive totius terrae promissionis nova descriptio
dct_alternative_sm: Palestinae sive totivs terrae promissionis nova descriptio
dct_description_sm: Bar scales on map given in “Mil. Germanica” and “Mil. Italica.”
Latitudinal and longitudinal lines along margins.
Index numbers throughout map but no apparent key.
Decorative cartouches, compass rose, ships, sea monsters.
From Ortelius’ Theatrum Orbis Terrarum, Latin edition, Antwerp, 1570.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 238.
"51" on verso, and Latin text entitled: Palaestina vel Terra Sancta.
